title: 天文高解析光譜儀
subcategoryTitle: 天文儀器與科學感測器
summary: 以 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 這類光纖饋入、真空溫控的階梯光柵光譜儀為對象，說明為何 1 m/s 的恆星速度只相當於偵測器上 18.7 nm 的譜線位移，再把階梯光柵與交叉色散、光展量與擾頻、環境穩定、ThAr／標準具／頻率梳校正、CCD 系統誤差與重心修正整合成可驗收的徑向速度量測鏈。
summaryEn: Using fibre-fed, vacuum-stabilised echelle spectrographs such as HARPS and ESPRESSO, show why a 1 m/s stellar velocity is only an 18.7 nm line shift on the detector, then integrate echelle and cross-dispersion, étendue and scrambling, environmental stability, ThAr, etalon and comb calibration, CCD systematics and barycentric correction into an acceptable radial-velocity measurement chain.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「徑向速度量測需求與解析力」與「階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power" and "Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 徑向速度量測需求與解析力：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Doppler shift of stellar lines” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 系外行星繞行時使恆星沿視線方向週期性前後運動，恆星吸收譜線因都卜勒效應位移 δλ/λ = v/c。地球質量行星繞類太陽恆星一年軌道只造成約 9 cm/s 的速度半振幅，木星約 12.5 m/s，因此光譜儀必須在數千條譜線上量出遠小於一個像素的位移。解析力 R = λ/Δλ 決定譜線被分開與取樣的程度：R 越高譜線側翼越陡、每條線攜帶的速度資訊越多，但每個解析元素分到的光子越少，所以 R 的選擇是解析度、通量與儀器尺寸之間的取捨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When an exoplanet orbits, its star moves periodically toward and away from us and its absorption lines shift by δλ/λ = v/c. An Earth-mass planet in a one-year orbit around a Sun-like star produces a velocity semi-amplitude of only about 9 cm/s and Jupiter about 12.5 m/s, so the spectrograph must measure shifts far smaller than a pixel across thousands of lines. Resolving power R = λ/Δλ sets how well lines are separated and sampled: higher R steepens line flanks and gives each line more velocity information, but spreads photons over more resolution elements, so choosing R trades resolution, throughput and instrument size. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Doppler shift of stellar lines”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：1 m/s 對應 δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹，在 λ = 550 nm 為 1.83 fm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 1 m/s corresponds to δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹, or 1.83 fm at λ = 550 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Doppler shift of stellar lines”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 徑向速度量測需求與解析力
knowledge.text: 系外行星繞行時使恆星沿視線方向週期性前後運動，恆星吸收譜線因都卜勒效應位移 δλ/λ = v/c。地球質量行星繞類太陽恆星一年軌道只造成約 9 cm/s 的速度半振幅，木星約 12.5 m/s，因此光譜儀必須在數千條譜線上量出遠小於一個像素的位移。
knowledge.textEn: When an exoplanet orbits, its star moves periodically toward and away from us and its absorption lines shift by δλ/λ = v/c. An Earth-mass planet in a one-year orbit around a Sun-like star produces a velocity semi-amplitude of only about 9 cm/s and Jupiter about 12.5 m/s, so the spectrograph must measure shifts far smaller than a pixel across thousands of lines.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「天文高解析光譜儀」的「徑向速度量測需求與解析力：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「觀測站：找回微弱訊號」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power: mechanism and system boundary” in “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Observatory: Recover a Faint Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「徑向速度量測需求與解析力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power" is correct?
options: 解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。
系外行星繞行時使恆星沿視線方向週期性前後運動，恆星吸收譜線因都卜勒效應位移 δλ/λ = v/c。
階梯光柵刻線越密，角色散就越大。
optionsEn: Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count.
When an exoplanet orbits, its star moves periodically toward and away from us and its absorption lines shift by δλ/λ = v/c.
A more finely ruled echelle always gives larger angular dispersion.
quiz.explanation: 系外行星繞行時使恆星沿視線方向週期性前後運動，恆星吸收譜線因都卜勒效應位移 δλ/λ = v/c。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When an exoplanet orbits, its star moves periodically toward and away from us and its absorption lines shift by δλ/λ = v/c. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 徑向速度量測需求與解析力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Doppler shift of stellar lines” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1 m/s 對應 δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹，在 λ = 550 nm 為 1.83 fm。R = 140 000 時解析元素 Δλ = 550/140 000 = 3.93 pm，相當於 c/R = 2141 m/s；若每個解析元素取樣 4 個 10 µm 像素，每像素 535 m/s，1 m/s 等於偵測器上 10 µm/535 = 18.7 nm 的譜線位移，約為像素的 1/535。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 1 m/s corresponds to δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹, or 1.83 fm at λ = 550 nm. At R = 140 000 the resolution element is Δλ = 550/140 000 = 3.93 pm, equivalent to c/R = 2141 m/s; sampled by four 10 µm pixels each pixel spans 535 m/s, so 1 m/s is a line shift of 10 µm/535 = 18.7 nm on the detector, about 1/535 of a pixel. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：觀測長期 RV 散佈小於 1 m/s 的 G、K 矮星與經月球或太陽望遠鏡導入的太陽光，量測譜線半高寬並換算實際交付的 R，與設計值比較；再用校正燈譜線的寬度與其佔用的像素數確認每像素的速度標度，寫入儀器設定檔供管線使用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe G and K dwarfs whose long-term RV scatter is below 1 m/s and sunlight fed through the Moon or a solar telescope, measure line FWHM and convert to the delivered R for comparison with the design; then use calibration-line widths and the number of pixels they cover to confirm the velocity scale per pixel and store it in the instrument configuration used by the pipeline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 1 m/s 對應 δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹，在 λ = 550 nm 為 1.83 fm。R = 140 000 時解析元素 Δλ = 550/140 000 = 3.93 pm，相當於 c/R = 2141 m/s；若每個解析元素取樣 4 個 10 µm 像素，每像素 535 m/s，1 m/s 等於偵測器上 10 µm/535 = 18.7 nm 的譜線位移，約為像素的 1/535。
knowledge.textEn: 1 m/s corresponds to δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹, or 1.83 fm at λ = 550 nm. At R = 140 000 the resolution element is Δλ = 550/140 000 = 3.93 pm, equivalent to c/R = 2141 m/s; sampled by four 10 µm pixels each pixel spans 535 m/s, so 1 m/s is a line shift of 10 µm/535 = 18.7 nm on the detector, about 1/535 of a pixel.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「徑向速度量測需求與解析力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power", which statement holds?
options: 只要光柵用零膨脹材料，溫度就不再重要。
曝光時間一直加倍，RV 誤差就會無限下降。
optionsEn: If the grating is made of zero-expansion material, temperature no longer matters.
Doubling the exposure time keeps reducing RV error without limit.
1 m/s corresponds to δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹, or 1.83 fm at λ = 550 nm.
quiz.explanation: 1 m/s 對應 δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹，在 λ = 550 nm 為 1.83 fm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 1 m/s corresponds to δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹, or 1.83 fm at λ = 550 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 徑向速度量測需求與解析力：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Doppler shift of stellar lines” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 觀測長期 RV 散佈小於 1 m/s 的 G、K 矮星與經月球或太陽望遠鏡導入的太陽光，量測譜線半高寬並換算實際交付的 R，與設計值比較；再用校正燈譜線的寬度與其佔用的像素數確認每像素的速度標度，寫入儀器設定檔供管線使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe G and K dwarfs whose long-term RV scatter is below 1 m/s and sunlight fed through the Moon or a solar telescope, measure line FWHM and convert to the delivered R for comparison with the design; then use calibration-line widths and the number of pixels they cover to confirm the velocity scale per pixel and store it in the instrument configuration used by the pipeline. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只看解析力規格而忽略取樣，每個解析元素少於 2 個像素時譜線欠取樣，像素內響應差異會轉成隨地球公轉速度改變的假訊號；反之若在口徑不足的望遠鏡上把 R 推得過高，每個解析元素的光子不足，RV 精度反而變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Quoting resolving power while ignoring sampling leaves lines undersampled below 2 pixels per resolution element, so intrapixel response differences become spurious signals that vary with Earth's orbital velocity; conversely, pushing R too high on a small aperture starves each element of photons and degrades RV precision.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 觀測長期 RV 散佈小於 1 m/s 的 G、K 矮星與經月球或太陽望遠鏡導入的太陽光，量測譜線半高寬並換算實際交付的 R，與設計值比較；再用校正燈譜線的寬度與其佔用的像素數確認每像素的速度標度，寫入儀器設定檔供管線使用。
knowledge.textEn: Observe G and K dwarfs whose long-term RV scatter is below 1 m/s and sunlight fed through the Moon or a solar telescope, measure line FWHM and convert to the delivered R for comparison with the design; then use calibration-line widths and the number of pixels they cover to confirm the velocity scale per pixel and store it in the instrument configuration used by the pipeline.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「徑向速度量測需求與解析力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power"?
options: 觀測長期 RV 散佈小於 1 m/s 的 G、K 矮星與經月球或太陽望遠鏡導入的太陽光，量測譜線半高寬並換算實際交付的 R，與設計值比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
CCD 像素是完美等距網格，只需校正波長即可。
optionsEn: Observe G and K dwarfs whose long-term RV scatter is below 1 m/s and sunlight fed through the Moon or a solar telescope, measure line FWHM and convert to the delivered R for comparison with the design.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
CCD pixels form a perfect grid, so only wavelength needs calibrating.
quiz.explanation: 觀測長期 RV 散佈小於 1 m/s 的 G、K 矮星與經月球或太陽望遠鏡導入的太陽光，量測譜線半高寬並換算實際交付的 R，與設計值比較；再用校正燈譜線的寬度與其佔用的像素數確認每像素的速度標度，寫入儀器設定檔供管線使用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Observe G and K dwarfs whose long-term RV scatter is below 1 m/s and sunlight fed through the Moon or a solar telescope, measure line FWHM and convert to the delivered R for comparison with the design; then use calibration-line widths and the number of pixels they cover to confirm the velocity scale per pixel and store it in the instrument configuration used by the pipeline. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 徑向速度量測需求與解析力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Doppler shift of stellar lines” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只看解析力規格而忽略取樣，每個解析元素少於 2 個像素時譜線欠取樣，像素內響應差異會轉成隨地球公轉速度改變的假訊號；反之若在口徑不足的望遠鏡上把 R 推得過高，每個解析元素的光子不足，RV 精度反而變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Quoting resolving power while ignoring sampling leaves lines undersampled below 2 pixels per resolution element, so intrapixel response differences become spurious signals that vary with Earth's orbital velocity; conversely, pushing R too high on a small aperture starves each element of photons and degrades RV precision. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解析力 R = λ/Δλ 決定譜線被分開與取樣的程度：R 越高譜線側翼越陡、每條線攜帶的速度資訊越多，但每個解析元素分到的光子越少，所以 R 的選擇是解析度、通量與儀器尺寸之間的取捨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Resolving power R = λ/Δλ sets how well lines are separated and sampled: higher R steepens line flanks and gives each line more velocity information, but spreads photons over more resolution elements, so choosing R trades resolution, throughput and instrument size.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看解析力規格而忽略取樣，每個解析元素少於 2 個像素時譜線欠取樣，像素內響應差異會轉成隨地球公轉速度改變的假訊號；反之若在口徑不足的望遠鏡上把 R 推得過高，每個解析元素的光子不足，RV 精度反而變差。
knowledge.textEn: Quoting resolving power while ignoring sampling leaves lines undersampled below 2 pixels per resolution element, so intrapixel response differences become spurious signals that vary with Earth's orbital velocity; conversely, pushing R too high on a small aperture starves each element of photons and degrades RV precision.

steps.title: 階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “R4 echelle and cross-disperser” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 階梯光柵以每毫米數十條的粗刻線在大入射角、高繞射級（m 約 60 到 160）下工作，滿足 mλ = d(sinα + sinβ)。在 Littrow 配置 α ≈ β ≈ θ_B，角色散 dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ 只取決於閃耀角，因此 R4（tanθ_B = 4）光柵的角色散比一般一級光柵高一個數量級。代價是相鄰繞射級重疊，每一級只有很窄的自由光譜範圍 FSR = λ/m，所以要用稜鏡或低刻線密度光柵在垂直方向做交叉色散，把數十個繞射級排成二維梯狀影像鋪滿大面積 CCD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An echelle uses coarse rulings of tens of grooves per millimetre at steep incidence and high orders, m of about 60 to 160, obeying mλ = d(sinα + sinβ). In Littrow, α ≈ β ≈ θ_B, the angular dispersion dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ depends only on the blaze angle, so an R4 grating with tanθ_B = 4 disperses an order of magnitude more than a first-order grating. The price is overlapping orders, each with a narrow free spectral range FSR = λ/m, so a prism or low-groove-density grating cross-disperses perpendicular to the echelle and stacks dozens of orders into a two-dimensional ladder that tiles a large CCD. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “R4 echelle and cross-disperser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：31.6 gr/mm 的 R4 光柵 d = 31.65 µm、θ_B = 75.96°。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An R4 grating with 31.6 gr/mm has d = 31.65 µm and θ_B = 75.96°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「階梯光柵刻線越密，角色散就越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A more finely ruled echelle always gives larger angular dispersion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “R4 echelle and cross-disperser”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “R4 echelle and cross-disperser” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：31.6 gr/mm 的 R4 光柵 d = 31.65 µm、θ_B = 75.96°。Littrow 下 m = 2d·sinθ_B/λ = 2×31.65×0.970/0.550 ≈ 111.6，取 m = 112，閃耀波長 548.2 nm，FSR = 548.2/112 ≈ 4.89 nm。角色散 2×4/550 nm = 14.5 mrad/nm；相機焦距 0.70 m 時線色散 10.2 µm/pm，3.93 pm 的解析元素佔 40 µm，即 4 個 10 µm 像素。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An R4 grating with 31.6 gr/mm has d = 31.65 µm and θ_B = 75.96°. In Littrow, m = 2d·sinθ_B/λ = 2×31.65×0.970/0.550 ≈ 111.6, so order 112 blazes at 548.2 nm with FSR = 548.2/112 ≈ 4.89 nm. Angular dispersion is 2×4/550 nm = 14.5 mrad/nm; a 0.70 m camera gives 10.2 µm/pm, so a 3.93 pm resolution element covers 40 µm, four 10 µm pixels. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 ThAr 燈與平場光照亮全部繞射級，追蹤每一級在偵測器上的軌跡，確認相鄰級間距大於光纖像在交叉色散方向的寬度再加背景餘量；以已知波長譜線核對各級的 m 值與色散解，並檢查閃耀函數峰值落在各級中央，自由光譜範圍邊緣的效率約降到峰值的 40%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Illuminate all orders with a ThAr lamp and a flat field, trace each order across the detector and confirm that inter-order spacing exceeds the fibre-image width in the cross-dispersion direction plus a background margin; check each order's m and dispersion solution against known lines and verify that the blaze peak sits at order centre with efficiency near 40% of peak at the free-spectral-range edges.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “R4 echelle and cross-disperser” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 ThAr 燈與平場光照亮全部繞射級，追蹤每一級在偵測器上的軌跡，確認相鄰級間距大於光纖像在交叉色散方向的寬度再加背景餘量；以已知波長譜線核對各級的 m 值與色散解，並檢查閃耀函數峰值落在各級中央，自由光譜範圍邊緣的效率約降到峰值的 40%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Illuminate all orders with a ThAr lamp and a flat field, trace each order across the detector and confirm that inter-order spacing exceeds the fibre-image width in the cross-dispersion direction plus a background margin; check each order's m and dispersion solution against known lines and verify that the blaze peak sits at order centre with efficiency near 40% of peak at the free-spectral-range edges. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：以稜鏡做交叉色散時紅端繞射級彼此靠近，光纖像翼部與散射光互相污染，背景扣除錯誤會讓深吸收線變淺並系統性移動譜線重心；光柵刻線的週期性誤差則產生 Rowland 鬼線，可能被誤認為恆星譜線而進入交叉相關遮罩。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With prism cross-dispersion the red orders crowd together, fibre-image wings and scattered light contaminate neighbours, and wrong background subtraction makes deep lines shallower and systematically moves their centroids; periodic ruling errors create Rowland ghosts that can be mistaken for stellar lines and enter the cross-correlation mask.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以稜鏡做交叉色散時紅端繞射級彼此靠近，光纖像翼部與散射光互相污染，背景扣除錯誤會讓深吸收線變淺並系統性移動譜線重心；光柵刻線的週期性誤差則產生 Rowland 鬼線，可能被誤認為恆星譜線而進入交叉相關遮罩。
knowledge.textEn: With prism cross-dispersion the red orders crowd together, fibre-image wings and scattered light contaminate neighbours, and wrong background subtraction makes deep lines shallower and systematically moves their centroids; periodic ruling errors create Rowland ghosts that can be mistaken for stellar lines and enter the cross-correlation mask.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。
以稜鏡做交叉色散時紅端繞射級彼此靠近，光纖像翼部與散射光互相污染，背景扣除錯誤會讓深吸收線變淺並系統性移動譜線重心。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision.

With prism cross-dispersion the red orders crowd together, fibre-image wings and scattered light contaminate neighbours, and wrong background subtraction makes deep lines shallower and systematically moves their centroids.
quiz.explanation: 以稜鏡做交叉色散時紅端繞射級彼此靠近，光纖像翼部與散射光互相污染，背景扣除錯誤會讓深吸收線變淺並系統性移動譜線重心；光柵刻線的週期性誤差則產生 Rowland 鬼線，可能被誤認為恆星譜線而進入交叉相關遮罩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With prism cross-dispersion the red orders crowd together, fibre-image wings and scattered light contaminate neighbours, and wrong background subtraction makes deep lines shallower and systematically moves their centroids; periodic ruling errors create Rowland ghosts that can be mistaken for stellar lines and enter the cross-correlation mask. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
